items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She went up and grabbed the bass, and I said to myself, Lord, have mercy. I said, this woman’s going to play.

ctx.x: Melissa – something like that – Shokum or Scrocum or something like that. Slocum.

At that time she looked just like Eve. She was about Eve’s size. She was taller. Oh, she was a fox. She went up and grabbed the bass, and I said to myself, Lord, have mercy. I said, this woman’s going to play. She took that bass and leaned back like this and went to town. The next time I saw her, she was bigger than that chair. I said, “Melissa” – because I had been talking about Melissa for about three years or four years. Is she still big?
